t_advice_summary_textbox.text: each gnome carries a basket in the colour red and yellow. The high scores come when you see the multiply of x 5 . Keep going with the basket that achieves the higher number and when the amounts lower then try switching to the other colour.

vb_textbox.text: Each gnome corresponds to a red or yellow basket. Try and work out which gnome is collecting from which basket and then select the gnome that tends to select the basket with higher amount of mushrooms. This does change from time to time so keep an eye out for these changes. The high collections come when you see the X 5 pop up.
